items.title: Septorhinoplasty: The Open Approach
items.fact_zh: 德国耳鼻喉科杂志刊出开放入路鼻中隔鼻整形专题，聚焦该入路的技术要点。
items.take_zh: 开放入路的价值在复杂病例的暴露与固定，不该当默认术式；条件允许时，闭合入路仍值得先考虑。
items.scene_zh: 病人问“开放会不会留疤”，关键在鼻小柱那一段切口，不在“开不开放”这四个字。
items.fact_en: A German ENT journal runs a focused piece on the open-approach septorhinoplasty and its technical points.
items.take_en: The open approach earns its place in complex cases, not as a default; consider a closed approach first when anatomy allows.
